band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources with at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4
band_change_evidence_test.reason: PARTIAL. Three Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification filings covering 87 workers in April 2025 are state regulatory records and are tier 4 in origin, but they were reached through an aggregator rather than a state registry, so the tier-4 claim is not fully verified. Data Center Dynamics and EE Times corroborate the layoff and the strategic pivot at tier 3. No fully verified tier-4 source was obtained.

key_evidence: SambaNova Systems publishes nothing that bears on compassion. No responsible-AI policy, no workforce data, no impact reporting, no failure disclosure. Thirty-nine of 40 subdimensions rest on absence of evidence.

The only located facts about how it treats people are a layoff of 77 employees, about 15% of the workforce, on 22 April 2025, and three statutory Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification filings covering 87 workers. Statutory notice is the legal minimum.
No adverse conduct was found. No lawsuits, no safety incidents, no labour findings, no regulatory action. The 22.8-point fall is entirely a disclosure gap.
The company is still operating independently with 407 employees as of June 2026, having raised funding rather than selling to Intel.
SambaNova and Typeface land on identical dimension vectors, because near-total absence of evidence produces the same floor. That is a floor artefact of the method, not a new seed.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 48.4 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder shared byte-for-byte with seven other ai-labs entities at consecutive alphabetical ranks; the rank is an artefact of the tie. No adverse conduct was located. The entire gap measures disclosure, not conduct. Applying a one-off baseline reset on evidence-absence alone would convert a calibration problem into a conduct finding, which the anti-false-positive screen forbids.
